name: csvWrite
description: Writes data such as a query, array of structs or array of arrays as CSV.

params.name: inputFormat
params.description: Format of the data being written.

params.name: outputFilePath
params.description: Path of the file to write the CSV to.

params.name: csvFormatConfiguration
params.description: Struct of output options. Keys include delimiter, quoteCharacter, quoteMode, escapeCharacter, encoding, recordSeparator, headerComments, nullString, trim, trailingDelimiter, autoflush, duplicateHeaderMode and readCSVConfig.
